facts.title: Keys in the macOS Keychain
facts.body: SSH keys and passwords stay on your Mac, with Secure Enclave and 1Password support.

facts.title: No agent on your servers
facts.body: Capstio connects over standard SSH, straight from your Mac to your VPS.

facts.title: End-to-end encrypted team vault
facts.body: Shared hosts, keys and recipes are encrypted on your devices; the server stores only ciphertext.

keys.label: The tools, one key each
keys.hint: Click a key, drag the boat, or just poke it and see what it says. With a key in focus, press 1 to 0.

hello: Oh, a visitor! Drag me anywhere.
Hi there! Come to sail with me?
annoyed: You're testing my patience, you know.
dizzy: Too much mouse shaking, I'm seasick!
Slow down, the whole sea is spinning!
edgeLeft: That's the left shore, no further!
End of the sea on the left!
edgeRight: That's the right shore, no further!
End of the sea on the right!
hold: Holding on to me for long?
You're holding the boat, you know.
fast: Slow down! I can't keep up with you.
Racing me? I can't sail that fast.
idle: Press a key, or drag me, either works.
sleepy: Yawn... wake me when you're back.
copy: Done. Read the command before you run it!
keyboard: Using the keyboard? Nice, keys 1 to 0!
leave: Where are you going? Come back!

apps: Every app in one list. Tidy!
docker: Docker cleanup? I'll show the space first.
Containers, images, volumes, networks... all here.
safeConfig: Editing config? A backup is made before every save.
Bad Nginx syntax? I tell you as you type.
terminal: Dangerous command? I blow the whistle!
Tabs, split view, and command history.
recipes: 24 command recipes, each with a risk level.
Can't remember a command? There's a recipe.
alerts: Disk full, CPU hot: I warn you while the app is open.
macOS notifications, only while Capstio is open.
sshSecurity: Who's knocking on SSH? Block an IP in one click.
SSH hardening tests a new connection and rolls back.
tunnels: Local, Remote and SOCKS tunnels. Dive in!
Connectivity is checked before you go.
ai: The AI only proposes read-only commands, you approve each.
Your own key, or Ollama running locally.
teams: An end-to-end encrypted vault with roles and a log.
